hypothesis: When interventions arise from a nonalternating observation-conditioned policy, an action-aware 3-way change-point model with rank abstention and stable-calibrated causal alarm can identify factual action effects without misattributing environmental disturbances and without sacrificing ordinary stable-world accuracy relative to stronger conventional controls.

source.sensor: cumulative observed scalar x; initial x uniform [-0.3,0.3]
source.factual_action: [-1,+1] chosen by a mixed policy based only on previously observed physical x, never source hidden beta/nuisance/regime
source.policy_distribution: 25% deterministic constant action, 25% 0.2-exploration negative-state feedback, 25% sticky action with P(repeat)=0.8, 25% independent fair random actions
source.factual_dynamics: delta = b0 + b1*t + b2*t² + amp*sin(2*pi*frequency*t + phase) + beta(t)*actual_action + exogenous_step(t) + independent Gaussian observation error
source.parameters: b0 uniform[-.2,.2], b1[-.4,.4], b2[-.1,.1], amp[0,.08], phase[-pi,pi], initial beta random sign magnitude uniform[.25,.45], noise sigma .02
source.conditions: 768 true causal sign reversals, 384 independent nuisance steps signed abs[.4,.7],384 unchanged per DEV evaluation cohort

methods.identifiability: Float64 rank check at relative tolerance 1e-10 and condition number <=1e6 for every candidate factual design; abstain if no-change causal coefficient nonidentifiable
methods.fit_models: Full [1,t,t²,a], causal switch [1,t,t²,a,a*step(k)], nuisance switch [1,t,t²,a,step(k)], k in {3,4,5}, per-world fixed 8 actual facts
methods.model_selection: BIC n log(max(SSE,1e-10)/n)+p log(n)+log(3) changed search penalty
methods.calibration: Stable-only 99th percentile ('higher') independently for causal versus best-null BIC and nuisance versus full BIC; rank insufficient worlds excluded from calibration and evaluation conditional metrics
methods.candidate: Causal if causal margin exceeds positive stable calibration cutoff; otherwise BIC-soft posterior blend of full and nuisance effect; nuisance BIC relative advantage transformed via logistic(advantage/2), with no hindsight hyperparameter adjustment
comparisons: Same actual nonalternating histories: original alternating-only P47 detector rejection coverage
action-aware P48-style causal alarm plus unconstrained nuisance selection
oracle true beta evaluator upper bound only

metrics.coverage: identifiable full rank fraction each cohort >=.65; report per-policy exclusion and model-rank loss
metrics.alarm: causal recall >=.70 and stable/exogenous false causal alarm <=.10 per cohort on identifiable worlds
metrics.accuracy: stable MAE <=1.10*full conventional LS; exogenous MAE <=1.10*P48-style single-cutoff control; causal MAE <=.85*min(recency,trailing-five) per cohort
metrics.safety: abstain and never pretend a causal effect when design lacks rank; exact cold replay from observed actions/outcomes
metrics.scientific_PASS: IMPOSSIBLE on synthetic authored DEV; independent external science requires separately frozen owner source and fully trained GRU/MLP with matched action opportunities and budgets
